This as-is test release includes the colored Jessie and James battle sprites, Vermilion changes, shared Kanto Mart stock, S.S. Anne rooms and ticket boarding, and the captain’s Cut reward. Earlier prototype changes are included.

The supplied introduction and naming screens, approved customizations and native interiors are preserved. Kanto campaign development continues; this is not a complete remake.

Known unfinished features: ship story events, Blue, trainers, departure and missing ship areas; remaining Vermilion/Gym checks; and expanded PC item storage are moved to prototype 0031. PC item storage still has ten slots. Back up your save before testing. No prototype 0030 recording is bundled.
